report_title: Q1 2026 Company Presentation (company source); FY2025 results via Ajaib Sekuritas company update (30 Apr 2026)
notes: FY2025: revenue US$249M (+53.6% YoY), EBITDA US$99M, net profit US$50M (+104.9% YoY), driven by higher gold production and prices (Ajaib Sekuritas company update 30 Apr 2026). Full FY2025 annual report not located; mine data from company Q1 2026 presentation (JORC reserves by AMC Consultants / KCMI). Reserves/resources stated at 100% project basis (not equity-adjusted). CIL expansion at Poboya (500 tpd to 2,000 tpd) targeted 2H26; underground ore from 2027; heap leach plant at Block-1 Poboya planned.

mines.processing: CIL (3 plants); heap leach planned at Block-1
mines.mine_notes: Operated by PT Citra Palu Minerals (96.97%), Palu, Central Sulawesi (85,180 ha Contract of Work). FY2025 gold output 71,886 oz (2,236 kg); FY2024 64,983 oz. Processed gold grade ~1.4-1.5 g/t in Q1 2025/2026. JORC Probable reserves 34.1 Mt @ 3.2 g/t Au, 7.8 g/t Ag (3.54 Moz Au, 8.6 Moz Ag): OP River Reef 5.7 Mt @ 1.7 Au (300 koz), OP Hill Reef 9.6 Mt @ 0.79 Au (240 koz), UG ore drives 2.5 Mt @ 4.5 Au (360 koz), UG stopes 16.3 Mt @ 5.0 Au (2.6 Moz). Cash cost guidance ~US$1,400-1,500/oz currently, declining to US$1,100-1,200/oz once underground matures. FY2025 silver output not disclosed (null).

Copper-gold project, Gorontalo, Sulawesi. Probable reserves 105.4 Mt @ 0.70% Cu, 0.33 g/t Au, 1.6 g/t Ag (613 kt Cu, 759 koz Au, 4.283 Moz Ag) at Sungai Mak; resource 392.3 Mt @ 0.49% Cu, 0.43 g/t Au. Drilling at Cabang Kiri (copper) and Motomboto (gold); reserve delineation ongoing.
Zinc-lead project, North Sumatra (Anjing Hitam & Lae Jahe). BRMS stake 49%; China Nonferrous (NFC) holds 51%. Reserve (100%): 11 Mt @ 11.5% Zn, 6.8% Pb; resource (100%): 25 Mt @ 10.1% Zn, 6.0% Pb.
Gold project, Aceh. Reserve (100%): 2.3 Mt @ 1.8 g/t Au (~133 koz); resource (100%): 6.8 Mt @ 1.58 g/t Au.
Gold project with IUP over 7,291 ha. Reserve (100%): 18.4 Mt @ 1.07 g/t Au (~633 koz); resource (100%): 75.3 Mt @ 0.85 g/t Au.
